audit_method: Read Git commit tree and each blob through git cat-file --batch; compare current raw bytes and SHA-256 without normalization or mutation. No collector/backend/browser/test execution.
scope_note: Every currently present tracked file beneath these prefixes, excluding generated Android build/.gradle/node_modules/__pycache__, agent artifacts and backend collection backups. Includes legacy Android modules, current featureapp, backend, browser probe, web probe and agent source/config/schema/tests. Historical backend records are classified separately. This is not a claim that the entire repository or generated outputs are Git-clean.
